description: Even with no one around you feel obligated to clean up the streets.  You find full cans of soda in the weirdest places.

As if the apocalypse itself wasn't enough, you are constantly looking for some trouble.  Zombies somehow sometimes sense your presence and approach you.  Fortunately, they always appear at a good distance from you.  Activate to toggle.

Anyone can pause and catch their breath but you're extremely good at doing so.  You can regenerate one-third of your stamina over ten seconds, once every fifteen minutes.  Being hit will interrupt the regeneration.
